title: Clinic-Closure Freeze Days on a Self-Pay Visit Package
content:
On unfreezing a Self-Pay Visit Package, the closure credit counts the package-funded appointments the clinic itself cancelled — appointment cancellations on the patient's Appointment Series history recorded with the cancellation reason "clinic cancelled" and funded by the self-pay package: **4 days** for two or more, **2 days** for exactly one, and none for none. The closure credit is added to the freeze-credit days after the freeze days have been capped.

| Clinic-cancelled package-funded appointments | Closure credit |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | 2 days |
| 2 or more | 4 days |

**Questions and answers**

*Does a cancellation the patient made count?* No. Only cancellations recorded with the reason "clinic cancelled" count, and only on appointments funded by the self-pay package.

*Does the credit grow beyond two cancellations?* No. Three or more clinic cancellations carry the same 4 days as two.

*Hypothetical:* a patient whose Appointment Series history shows one clinic-cancelled package-funded appointment and freeze days capped at 21 receives 21 days and a 2-day closure credit.
